text.en:
Kills with <primary/> Primary and <heavy/> Power Weapons grant #e${10 * #d}% Grenade Ability Energy.
MOST <special/> Special Weapons grant #e${20 * #d}%.

Trace Rifles and Grenade Launchers grant half of what other Special Weapons give.

Using your Grenade Ability <title refills [G_refill] /> the Magazine.
3 second cooldown between Magazine Refills.

enhanced (
var d = 1.1
#e Grenade Ability Energy gains are increased by 10%.
)
text.zh-chs:
<primary/> 主武器和 <heavy/> 重武器击杀可获取 #e${10 * #d}% 手雷技能能量。
大多数 <special/> 特殊武器获取 #e${20 * #d}% 能量。

追踪步枪和榴弹发射器相较其他特殊武器，仅获得一半能量。

使用手雷技能将 <title 重新装填 [G_refill] /> 弹匣。
重新装填效果有 3 秒冷却时间。

enhanced (
var d = 1.1
#e 能量获取量提升 10%。
)
